testPlan.title: Card hints and help for span picks

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: The card says how to pick
test.hint: Smooth tool. Read the lines under picks and in NEXT, before and after picking a span. They say how to move an end. PASS if they read well.

test.title: Help open: the card stays clear
test.hint: Hold Smooth and open its help. The tool card moves beside it, and nothing shows through the help. PASS if so.

test.title: Smooth's help reads right
test.hint: Hold the Smooth tool and open its help. It says the first click stays put and the end follows a loop. PASS if it reads well.

test.title: Move from the popup: carry the end round
test.hint: Select mode: click two points on the loop, choose move. Click on past the far end round the loop. The first point stays. PASS if so.
